gallery.filename: Cytiau Celtaidd - Celtic Iron Age Huts at Mynydd Twr, Caergybi (Holyhead), Wales 2021 01.jpg
gallery.title: File:Cytiau Celtaidd - Celtic Iron Age Huts at Mynydd Twr, Caergybi (Holyhead), Wales 2021 01.jpg
gallery.source: Cytiau Celtaidd - Celtic Iron Age Huts at Mynydd Twr, Caergybi (Holyhead), Wales 2021 01
gallery.description:
Celtic Iron Age Huts at Mynydd Twr, Caergybi (Holyhead), Wales 2021. These structures are of two main types: round and rectangular. 
There are 13 round huts, with diameter between 3.8 m and 8 m. The walls are of dry-stone construction and are generally 0.5 - 1 m high and 1 - 1.25 m wide.

The rectangular structures vary between 4 m and 4.75 m long, 1.25 and 1.9 m wide, and are about 1 m deep.
